description: Grist table schema for storing OpenRouter LLM models data

columns.name: Name
columns.description: Display name of the model (e.g., 'Grok Code Fast')

columns.name: Description
columns.description: Detailed description of the model's capabilities and use cases

columns.name: PricingInput
columns.description: Price per million input tokens in USD (e.g., 0.5, 3.0)

columns.name: PricingOutput
columns.description: Price per million output tokens in USD (e.g., 1.5, 15.0)

columns.name: Capabilities
columns.description: Comma-separated list of capabilities (e.g., 'code-generation, debugging, refactoring')

columns.name: LastUpdated
columns.description: Timestamp of last update to this record

steps: 1. Create a new Grist document or open an existing one
3. Create columns matching the schema above with appropriate types
4. Get your API key from Grist (Profile > API → Create API Key)
5. Get your Document ID from the URL (https://docs.getgrist.com/..../DOC_ID/...)
6. Update the constants in Tvnetwork copy.html:
7. Uncomment the syncModelsToGrist() line in initializeCarousels() to enable auto-sync

sampleData: See openrouter-models.json for sample data that can be imported
